subgroup_rule: The four development relation-decisive pairs remain a fixed subgroup. Independent reference changes or ambiguities are reported without replacing pairs or changing rules.
analysis: Report all ten pairs, the fixed four-pair subgroup, and the complementary six pairs. Primary contrast: linked minus relation-broken evidence. Other MiniMax contrasts are secondary. Equal weights for AB/BA and both paraphrases. Unresolved selections score zero on determinate references; ambiguous references are separate. Reused policies are not independent pairs or API samples.
stopping_rule: One frozen batch per provider; never retry attempted calls. No probes, seed additions, retraining, new requirements, or adaptive prompts. A provider or transport error ends that provider's batch; still attempt the other authorized provider. Report incomplete batches explicitly and close the study regardless of direction.
qualification_revision: Remove the twenty-relational-pair dispatch requirement only for this explicitly authorized fixed-cohort auxiliary study. Preserve the prior failure, all capability thresholds and operational definitions. This amendment follows development results and precedes independent reference and model results.
